CAR.line_en: Boot lid up, cooler out, cups handed round before kickoff.
CAR.line_zh: 后备箱一掀、冰箱一摆，开球前先把杯子递一圈。

BEACH.line_en: Sand, salt and no glass on the beach — this is where shatterproof pays for itself.
BEACH.line_zh: 沙子、盐分、海滩上不能有玻璃 —— 摔不碎在这一场最值钱。

CAMP.line_en: One cup per person, washed in the lake, back in the crate by dark.
CAMP.line_zh: 一人一只，湖边冲一下就收进箱子，天黑前归位。

BBQ.line_en: Long tables, second helpings, cups that survive being set down on hot stone.
BBQ.line_zh: 长桌连着摆，一轮接一轮 —— 杯子在烫石台面上放下也不能软。

YACHT.line_en: Aft deck at golden hour, where the glass has to look right and still not break.
YACHT.line_zh: 黄昏后甲板 —— 要好看，更要摔了不出事。

BAR.line_en: First pour to last call, stacked and re-stocked three times a night.
BAR.line_zh: 从第一杯到打烊，一晚上要补三次货的那种台子。
